doc: SELFAUDIT-1: the probed failure-mode register the tick Worker runs itself every tick (worker/src/selfaudit.js). Each probe is one read-only SELECT returning 1 when healthy. A red probe files or reopens item FM-<id> (owner role, closing probe selfaudit:<id>); the item may only close when its probe is green, never by a message. Detection, owner, trigger and remedy are data here; nothing waits on a person.

modes.failure: Items are dispatched again and again and never produce an outcome (the claim lapses, the reaper releases it, the tick re-dispatches it).
modes.root_cause: No consumer closes a dispatch: dispatches stay 'queued' and the re-dispatch had no loop-breaker.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM (SELECT item_id FROM dispatches WHERE at >= datetime('now','-3 days') GROUP BY item_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=3 AND item_id IS NOT NULL AND item_id NOT IN (SELECT item_id FROM outcomes WHERE item_id IS NOT NULL) AND item_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM items WHERE status IN ('blocked','done','superseded','cancelled')))
modes.remedy: tick dispatch step blocks an item after max_redispatch dispatches without an outcome and files LOOPBREAK-<item> (guiding directive 2)

modes.failure: k_eff counts zero deploys because no independent deploy evidence reaches D1.
modes.root_cause: Q-CRIT-COLLECTORS was filed and never built, so criticality_samples and verified deploy outcomes stay empty.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM outcomes WHERE action_class='deploy' AND result='verified' AND evidence LIKE 'probe:%' AND at >= datetime('now','-14 days')
modes.remedy: ingestDeploys reads ops/deploys.jsonl (live_matches_commit rows, written by the post-deploy verifier) into outcomes each tick

modes.failure: k_eff is below k_min: loops cost more than they yield.
modes.root_cause: Numerator starved (no deploy evidence) and denominator inflated by phantom re-dispatches.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT json_extract(value,'$.k_eff') FROM org WHERE key='criticality'),0) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
modes.remedy: raise verified deploys or cut dispatch waste; the criticality step keeps an ORIGIN item at the head until it holds

modes.failure: The tick has not finished a run in the last 30 minutes.
modes.root_cause: cron not firing or the Worker failing before the tick row finishes.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM tick_runs WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= datetime('now','-30 minutes')
modes.remedy: second route: executor workflow and GitHub Actions dispatch (EXEC-SPARK-1)

modes.failure: The server-side sweeper last pass was not ok, or has not run for 2 hours.
modes.root_cause: GitHub App token missing or registered on the wrong account (REPO-ACCESS-1).
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT status='ok' AND at >= datetime('now','-2 hours') FROM sweeper_runs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),0)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
modes.remedy: adopt the right installation by code, register the App under the org; consent screen is the single identity-bound step

modes.failure: An open gate card has no default in effect, so an owner-only step stalls work.
modes.root_cause: an identity-bound step with no staged default in effect.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM gate_cards WHERE status='open' AND (default_in_effect IS NULL OR default_in_effect='')
modes.remedy: stage the default and let the loop proceed on it

modes.failure: An item left the active set with no disposition.
modes.root_cause: a path that sets done without a disposition.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM outcomes WHERE result='silent_drop' AND at >= datetime('now','-1 day')
modes.remedy: reconcile reopens the item; fix the writer
